episode.title: Episode 7: Book the Right Time in One Tap
episode.description: Acme's Smart Scheduling suggests open times from your calendars, books them from the conversation and reminds the customer before the meeting.

script.instructions: Two hosts walk a sales team through Smart Scheduling; upbeat, practical.
script.intro: Welcome to the Acme Deep Dive. Today: Smart Scheduling.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: So the customer just picks a time from the message?

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: [laughs] Exactly. Acme suggests the open times from your calendars, and the customer taps one.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: And if they need to move it later?

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: [excited] They reply, and the meeting moves. Reminders go out before it, too.

script.outro: That is it for this episode of the Acme Deep Dive.
